headline: Sullivan Middle School bathroom petition, Chromebook and MacBook lease up to five years, and $157,500 website contract.
summary: The meeting opens with closed-door talks on contract negotiations with several Educational Association of Worcester units. Members will also take up a student petition on Sullivan Middle School bathrooms and a $175,000 state education grant.
items: Executive session on contract negotiations with Educational Association of Worcester bargaining units
Executive session to review minutes from the October 8 and October 22, 2026 meetings
Burncoat Quadrivium Honors Choir performs the National Anthem

Recognition of the Burncoat Quadrivium Honors Choir for its Gold Medal and invitations to perform at Carnegie Hall in 2027 and 2028
Public comment, two minutes per speaker

FY26 budget report and transfers, approved and filed
FY27 budget report, approved and held for updates
Boundary realignment presentation, held for future updates
Doherty Biomedical Academy program update, approved and filed
